title: Derived extension-by-zero and restriction adjunction
statement: Let (X, O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let j:U \to X be an open inclusion, and let j_! be the exact extension-by-zero functor left adjoint to restriction on sheaves of O-modules [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. Applying these exact functors termwise to complexes gives functors on the derived categories D(O_U) and D(O_X) of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every A in D(O_U) and B in D(O_X) there is a natural bijection Hom_{D(O_X)}(j_! A, B) = Hom_{D(O_U)}(A, B restricted to U).
